items.title: The henselization and strict henselization of a P-ring are P-rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the henselization and the strict henselization of a Noetherian local P-ring remain P-rings. The henselization case is quoted from the companion result for the henselian pair, and the strict henselization case is reduced to the condition on formal fibres. The computation then proceeds at a prime of the strict henselization: the fibre of the strict henselization over the residue field of the prime below is a product of residue fields by the fibre computation, which turns the product of the formal fibres at the primes over that residue field into a single tensor product, and the map from the completion of the ring to the completion of its strict henselization is formally smooth, hence regular, so the permanence conditions (C), (B) and (E) give property P for the fibre of the strict henselization at the chosen prime.
